name: pet-oasis-web
description: Frontend web do Pet Oasis — vitrine, área do cliente e back-office sobre a API REST do pet shop.
author: Rafael Maia da Fonseca

scripts.prod:up: docker compose -p pet-oasis-web-prod --env-file .env.production -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml up --build --wait -d
scripts.prod:down: docker compose -p pet-oasis-web-prod --env-file .env.production -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml down
scripts.prod:logs: docker compose -p pet-oasis-web-prod --env-file .env.production -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f
